title: Toward satisfactory public accessibility: A crowdsourcing approach through online reviews to inclusive urban design

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment analysis of crowdsourced Google Maps reviews using a fine-tuned Llama 3 model to evaluate public attitudes and identify physical/service barriers regarding accessibility for individuals with disabilities across various Points of Interest (POIs).

Spatial regression modeling comparing regional accessibility sentiments against socio-spatial factors like poverty rates, median income, and education levels to identify systemic disparities in urban infrastructure funding and quality.

Spatial regression modeling to correlate public sentiment regarding urban accessibility with the racial and ethnic demographic composition of different regions (e.g., proportions of White, African American, and Hispanic populations).

Regression modeling assessing the correlation between regional accessibility sentiment and age demographics, specifically evaluating the higher sensitivity and negative experiences reported in areas with larger elderly populations (age 65 and older).
